verdict.rationale: Clerk documents OAuth/OIDC support for social sign-in and Enterprise SSO (including OIDC), scoped OAuth access, and automatic session-token (JWT) management so developers don't hand-roll token issuance or refresh — the core value prop of abstracting protocol details. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions PKCE support or explicit refresh-token rotation mechanics, leaving some protocol specifics unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of authorization-code-with-PKCE flow support, explicit refresh-token issuance/rotation details, and independent hands-on confirmation of OAuth/OIDC flow correctness.
